stalls.summaryZh: 天冷時最受歡迎的暖身湯品。

stalls.summaryEn: Light, refreshing cold noodles that work as breakfast; portions run small, but the miso egg-drop soup gets a special nod.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：內湖不是美食沙漠！內行才知6銅板價巷弄美食

stalls.summaryEn: A local office-worker favorite: vinegar noodles with fragrant fried shallots, a well-balanced vinegar-soy dressing and thin noodles that keep their bite.

stalls.summaryEn: A 20-plus-year late-night stall with queues; egg tofu is crisp outside and silky inside, and the cutlet is fried then brushed with a sweet-savory glaze and grilled.

stalls.summaryEn: Hand-rolled wrappers around a juicy filling sweetened with onion; one of the lane's popular spots.
